sources.title: Fraser Health Statement of Financial Information 2015/16: employee remuneration and expenses
sources.scopeDescription: Named employee payments equal to or greater than $75,000; employee schedule only
notes: Employee schedule only. The published threshold is inclusive: payments equal to or greater than $75,000. Under-threshold aggregates are excluded; job titles are not supplied.

The source states that the schedule is on a cash basis and is not directly reconcilable to accrual-basis financial statements. Employer benefit costs, contracted labour and physician fees are excluded from this schedule.
Names, including initials and punctuation, are retained as printed. Repeated names remain separate rows and do not establish a unique person.
Dash expense cells remain missing, not zero; printed negative recoveries and explicit zero amounts are preserved.

Displayed named remuneration minus its printed subtotal is $78; the corresponding expense difference is $9. Both fit the recorded independent whole-dollar rounding bound; the cause is not established, no amount is adjusted and exact reconciliation is not claimed.
